character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Chibi 4-head-tall JRPG mage cadet, female, front view idle pose. Long platinum-blond hair in a high ponytail with straight bangs, tan skin. Black off-shoulder long dress with gold trim and green gem accents, high thigh slit, detached black sleeves, ornate gold waist ornament, black heeled boots with gold. Gold diamond emblem. Elegant calm expression. Dark-fantasy magic-school attire, black and gold palette. Crisp pixel art, bold dark outline, flat cel shading.
